summary.name: Elements of AI
summary.one_liner: A free online course series from MinnaLearn and the University of Helsinki that teaches what AI is and how to build AI methods, with no complicated math required for the introductory course.
use_cases: learning what AI is without programming
understanding what AI can and cannot do
learning AI algorithms with Python basics
company AI literacy training for staff
summary.what_it_does: The page describes two free self-paced online courses. Part 1, Introduction to AI, covers what AI is, what it can and cannot do, and how it affects everyday life, with no complicated math or programming required. Part 2, Building AI, covers the algorithms used to create AI methods and recommends some basic Python skills. The courses combine theory with practical exercises. The page also promotes paid corporate AI literacy training (Get AI Ready, mapped to the EU AI Act) and a certificate on general AI literacy.
notable: Created by MinnaLearn and the University of Helsinki, started in spring 2018
Reports over 2 million sign-ups and graduates from over 170 countries
Part 2 Building AI recommends basic Python programming skills
Offers a general AI literacy certificate
caveats: Company AI literacy training (Get AI Ready) and the certificate are promoted as offerings for companies and individuals; pricing for these is not stated on the page
Building AI expects some basic Python programming skills
